appearance.title: Appearance (Pedro Sánchez's idea)
appearance.themeDescription: Day, night, or let Escriba follow your system mode.
appearance.textSizeDescription: Scales the whole interface. For tired eyes or comfortable reading.
appearance.calmModeDescription: Turns the whole app down: no motion, more air, larger text and flat surfaces. Applies while you dictate too.
appearance.highContrastDescription: Stronger ink and sharper borders, without blurred glass.
appearance.colorblindDescription: Success and recording states switch to a safe cyan/violet pair instead of green and red.
appearance.alwaysFocusDescription: Keeps the focus ring visible with the mouse too, not only when navigating by keyboard.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.description: Lets Escriba type the dictated text into other apps.

microphone.title: Microphone
microphone.description: Lets Escriba hear your voice to transcribe it.

screen.title: Screen & audio recording
screen.description: Lets Sessions capture system audio (the screen itself is not recorded).

faithfulMode.label: Faithful mode: don't change my words
faithfulMode.description: The normal shortcut pastes the model's text as-is: no filler or repetition removal, custom dictionary, restored accents, emojis, numerals, automatic translation, per-app tone, AI, or replacements. Smart Writing, translate, and edit shortcuts still transform text when you use them.

reviewBeforePaste.label: Review before pasting
reviewBeforePaste.description: The dictation shows on screen before it is typed: paste it, discard it, or dictate a correction with your shortcut. For delicate emails and formal documents.

dictatedEmojis.label: Dictated emojis
dictatedEmojis.description: Say "emoji" plus its Spanish name and the symbol appears: "emoji cara feliz" becomes 🙂. Names come from Unicode CLDR plus natural aliases.

spokenNumerals.label: Spoken numbers as digits
spokenNumerals.description: Long number phrases become digits: "tres millones y medio" turns into 3.500.000. Only unambiguous sequences convert; "uno de los problemas" stays untouched.

numeralsSpreadsheet.label: Aggressive numbers in spreadsheets
numeralsSpreadsheet.description: With Excel, Numbers or LibreOffice Calc in front, even single numbers become digits: say "cinco" and 5 is typed. Google Sheets in a browser can't be detected.

readSelectionVoice.title: Reading voice
readSelectionVoice.description: Choose the system voice or Escriba's included local voice for Read Selection.

pauseMedia.description: Pause Music/Spotify while you dictate and resume when you finish. Only what was playing gets paused.

noiseSuppression.label: Background noise suppression
noiseSuppression.description: Clean up mic noise (fan, keyboard, traffic) before transcribing. Runs locally.

lazyStreamClose.description: 録音停止後マイクを30秒間有効なままにし、連続した文字起こしの遅延を軽減します。Bluetooth 音声品質に影響する場合があります。

transcribe.description: transcribe.cpp (Whisper 系) モデルのハードウェアアクセラレーション。「自動」では利用可能な場合 GPU を使用します (macOS では Metal、Windows/Linux では Vulkan)。

ort.title: ONNX アクセラレーション
ort.description: ONNX モデルのハードウェアアクセラレーション (Parakeet、Canary、Moonshine など)。Windows の DirectML は実験的です。モデルの文字起こしに失敗する場合があります。

startHidden.label: 非表示で起動
startHidden.description: ウィンドウを開かずにシステムトレイに起動。

autostart.label: 起動時に実行
autostart.description: コンピューターにログインしたときに Escriba を自動的に起動。

showTrayIcon.label: トレイアイコンを表示
showTrayIcon.description: システムトレイに Escriba のアイコンを表示します。

style.title: Floating indicator
style.description: 録音中のオーバーレイを選択します。「なし」は非表示、「ミニマル」はコンパクトなカプセル型表示、「ライブ」はリアルタイムで文字起こしを表示します(ストリーミング対応モデルのみ。モデル選択画面の「ストリーミング」表示を確認してください)。Linux では「なし」を推奨します。

position.title: オーバーレイの位置
position.description: 録音と文字起こし中に表示するオーバーレイが表示される位置を選択します。

pasteMethod.title: 貼り付け方法
pasteMethod.description: テキストの挿入方法を選択。「直接」はシステム入力でタイピングをシミュレート。「なし」は貼り付けをスキップし、履歴/クリップボードのみ更新。

typingTool.title: タイピングツール
typingTool.description: 直接貼り付け方式で使用する Linux のタイピングツールを選択します。Auto は自動的に最適なツールを検出して使用します。

clipboardHandling.title: クリップボードの処理
clipboardHandling.description: クリップボードを変更しないを選択すると、文字起こし後も現在のクリップボード内容が保持されます。クリップボードにコピーを選択すると、貼り付け後も文字起こし結果がクリップボードに残ります。

options.dontModify: クリップボードを変更しない

autoSubmit.title: 自動送信

translateToEnglish.label: 英語に翻訳

customWords.title: カスタム単語

voiceActivityDetection.title: 音声区間検出 (VAD)
voiceActivityDetection.description: 録音から無音部分を除去します。ストリーミング対応モデルはより長い音声検出区間を使用します。VAD を無効にすると音声をそのまま録音します。

postProcessing.heroSubtitle: After you dictate, Escriba can fix, rewrite, summarize or translate your text with AI. You pick the style; the result is ready to paste.

natural.label: Natural dictation
natural.in: hey uh I wanted to let you know that tomorrow I I won't be able to make the meeting
natural.out: I wanted to let you know that tomorrow I won't be able to make the meeting.

email.label: Professional email
email.in: tell the client the report is ready and I'll send it today
email.out:
Dear client,

The report is now ready and I will send it to you today.

Best regards.

notes.label: Quick notes
notes.in: buy batteries call the dentist and finish the proposal before friday
notes.out:
• Buy batteries
• Call the dentist
• Finish the proposal before Friday

translate.label: Translation
translate.in: see you tomorrow at ten at the entrance
translate.out: Nos vemos mañana a las diez en la entrada.

pluminHelp.guideFallback: Verified answer from Escriba's built-in guide.

answers.troubleshooting: Check that a transcription model is selected, the correct microphone is active, microphone and Accessibility permissions are granted, and the shortcut is not used by another app. Open General to review those controls.
answers.shortcut: Open General and select the shortcut you want to change. Enter a new combination that is not already reserved by the system or another app.
answers.privacy: Transcription and the local writing engine run on your computer. Cloud providers are optional and only run if you configure them; saved history is encrypted and saving audio is off by default.
answers.microphone: Choose the microphone in General. If it is missing, refresh the device list and verify the operating system's microphone permission.
answers.models: Models lets you download, select and remove transcription engines. Parakeet V3 is the balanced recommendation; Whisper large-v3-turbo prioritizes spelling quality.
answers.history: History keeps your dictation text so you can search, copy, save or retry it. Saving recordings is optional and off by default; when enabled, text and audio are encrypted at rest.
answers.studio: Use Studio to transcribe an audio or video file without the microphone. You can review its segments and export TXT, JSON, SRT or VTT.
answers.translator: Translator handles turns between two languages and keeps brief context. Interpreter is for a live room, while Sessions can turn a longer conversation into a document.
answers.writing: Smart Writing can correct, translate or change the tone of a dictation with the local engine. Configure its templates and shortcut in Smart Writing.
answers.obsidian: Choose your vault in General. Escriba can export reviewed notes, maintain an index, link mentions and append dictations to a daily inbox.
answers.updates: Finding an update never installs it automatically: you must explicitly select “Update available”. Portable installations show the manual update path instead.
answers.overview: I can help with dictation and permissions, shortcuts, models, privacy, History, Studio, Translator, Smart Writing, Obsidian and updates. Ask about one of those and I will take you to the right place.
